injectionLagP95Ms.why: Scheduled-vs-actual update fire time. Backlog here is exactly the 'stale data' symptom seen on Pixel 3 XL. p95 must stay near one 40ms frame.

injectionLagMaxMs.why: A single stall of 5+ frames is a visible freeze of a driving instrument, even if p95 looks fine.

longestTaskMs.why: One long task blocks every queued update behind it. Applies after warm-up only.

warmupMs.why: JIT and layout spikes settle within ~2s. At 20s run the warmup takes 10% of wall-clock instead of 25% — acceptable trade.

cpuThrottle.why: CDP CPU throttle factor approximating a Pixel 3 XL-class device on a CI runner. Calibrated in the rollout task; adjust this single number if too lenient/harsh.

defaultDurationMs.why: Compressed scenario hits every code path 2-3x in 20s. With 2s warmup, ~18s of steady frames — enough for stable p95 and covering all event types.

viewport.why: Landscape dashboard viewport on phone-class hardware. The apps render sideways in-car, so CI should not benchmark a portrait phone page.
